findings.reason: Each move repeats one identical paragraph for six different dimensions, then appends a generic definition. This does not explain each dimension's actual source-specific merits/limitations as the contract requires. Write distinct source-grounded explanations of inference, support, engagement, burden contact, clarity, calibration as appropriate, separating consequences rather than reusing a flaw six times. Controller prescribes no values.

All six rationales say 'garbled names ... reduce the evidential force'. This explicitly turns caption recognition corruption into a participant rating limitation, prohibited by frozen source restrictions. Assess only recoverable founder-plus-legend claim and actual support, keeping transcription/assessment confidence separate. Independently disclose whether the prohibited consideration affected unsaved values and correct within this unsaved context.

Do not use audio-sensitive handoffs or acquisition uncertainty as quality defects. In revised dimension explanations, keep source confidence separate from ratings and do not infer concessions from uncertain words.
